misdiagnosed_condition: Initially misdiagnosed as chronic gastritis and enteritis (慢性胃炎肠炎); acute myocardial infarction was ruled out before deterioration
key_clinical_findings: persistent chest and abdominal pain with history of hypertension and cerebral infarction; rising cardiac injury markers (心肌损伤检查结果数值递增); possible occult cardiovascular disease
patient_response_style: A 61-year-old male with abdominal pain and shortness of breath, describing his symptoms as 'stomach ache' and 'feeling short of breath', with discomfort in his shoulders and back. He may downplay cardiac symptoms, attributing them to indigestion, and mention taking 'Suxiao Jiuxin Wan' (a traditional Chinese medicine for heart symptoms) without realizing the severity.

old_carts.onset: 体检发现 (discovered during health checkup)
old_carts.character: 无症状 (asymptomatic)

ice.ideas: 患者可能认为甲状腺肿物是良性结节，手术切除即可治愈。
ice.concerns: 担心手术风险及术后恢复。
ice.expectations: 期望通过手术彻底切除肿瘤，恢复正常生活。

medication_history: 术后服用优甲乐 (levothyroxine) 及钙剂、维生素D
final_diagnosis: Hypoparathyroidism, Post-procedural Hypocalcemia, Thyroid Carcinoma
differential_diagnoses: 原发性甲状旁腺功能减退
低钙血症其他原因（如肾功能不全、维生素D缺乏）
misdiagnosed_condition: 医源性甲状旁腺功能损伤（单侧误切）
key_clinical_findings: 术后血清总钙及甲状旁腺素（PTH）进行性降低（最低3.16pg/mL），空腹血钙1.93mmol/L，确诊为永久性甲状旁腺功能低下
patient_response_style: 患者为37岁女性，职业为校医，可能对医疗过程有一定了解。术后出现顽固性低钙血症，表现为手足抽搐、麻木、肌肉痉挛，患者会描述为‘手脚抽筋、发麻，感觉像要抽过去一样’，情绪上可能焦虑、担忧，担心需要终生服药。
